title: When the saxophone came in
summary: Asked about the saxophone, Howard says his teachers got him onto it after teaching him all they could.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: What I am hearing now is that you were a cornet player and a clarinet player. When did the saxophone come in at what point and why?
Why did the saxophone come in?
I see pictures of you with the tenor sax.
You know why. Because they got me to play a saxophone after they taught me all they could on -- anyway, they taught me a lot of things to play.
Did you play the soprano sax? like Stanley Bechet?
Yeah, I played. But only in a few concerts, you know. I can't understand -- I am trying to think. Buddy, can I take this down for a minute.
